summary: To start a Snort rule playbook: ids_rule supports only Snort and needs root on the Snort server. Install it with ansible-galaxy install ansible_security.ids_rule, create add_snort_rule.yml targeting hosts snort with become: true and vars ids_provider: snort.
questions: What is ids_provider in the ids_rule role?
Do I need root to add Snort rules with Ansible?
